purpose: Stable ML-to-system interface for VoiceGuard. V2 remains the primary acoustic detector; prosody is secondary evidence; speaker consistency is optional/unavailable unless a trusted reference exists; risk is the final ML evidence-layer output.

audio.format: PCM audio accepted by production inference wrapper
audio.preprocessing: VoiceGuardAudioPreprocessor: mono 16 kHz, peak normalization, pad/truncate to 10 s

quality_context.description: Optional stream/network/channel quality metadata. When supplied, these fields are passed to the audio quality interface and affect evidence confidence, not spoof evidence.

speaker_reference.description: Reserved trusted historical enrollment/reference representation. The current production ML layer does not perform speaker-consistency inference; without a trusted reference, speaker consistency remains UNAVAILABLE.

decision_semantics.spoof_probability: Frozen V2 neural detector probability for class 1 (spoof).
decision_semantics.prosody_evidence: Secondary evidence. It must not be interpreted as an independent final detector.
decision_semantics.speaker_consistency: Reserved optional cross-session evidence. Current production implementation does not use speaker consistency and reports it as UNAVAILABLE.
decision_semantics.quality: Poor/degraded quality lowers confidence in evidence. It must not automatically increase spoof evidence.
decision_semantics.risk: Risk engine output combines the frozen V2 primary evidence with deployable prosody evidence while attenuating evidence according to quality and evidence confidence.

quality_interface.quality_score_definition: Normalized 0..1 estimate of whether the current audio window is sufficiently reliable for model evidence.
required_checks: optional SNR estimate when reference/noise estimate is available
stream integrity indicators such as packet loss, jitter, and codec/compression degradation when available

quality_states.DEGRADED: Evidence may be used with reduced confidence.
quality_states.POOR: Do not treat the window as strong evidence; request/accumulate a better window.
quality_states.INVALID: No valid inference/evidence should be emitted.

quality_interface.principle: Quality degradation reduces evidence confidence rather than becoming spoof evidence.
quality_interface.streaming_policy: Accumulate evidence from reliable windows; do not let a single corrupted/low-quality window dominate the decision.

integration_notes.speaker_consistency: UNAVAILABLE in the current production ML layer unless a future explicitly approved implementation adds trusted-reference comparison.
integration_notes.streaming: Microphone, call, transport, buffering, windowing, session management, and temporal accumulation orchestration remain outside this ML predictor.
integration_notes.backend_responsibility: The backend supplies validated audio windows and stream context, calls the predictor, consumes the returned contract, and owns API/security/application actions.
integration_notes.ml_responsibility: The ML layer owns preprocessing, feature extraction, frozen V2 inference, prosody evidence, audio-quality interpretation, evidence fusion, and risk calculation.
integration_notes.model_change_policy: Any checkpoint, threshold, feature-contract, output-schema, or evidence-weight change requires an explicit contract/version review before backend integration.

reasons: Example only; values are illustrative, not benchmark predictions.

notes: Example only; values are illustrative, not benchmark predictions.
